apps.name: Auris
apps.subtitle: Music player with lyrics, karaoke and Listen Together.
apps.localizedDescription: Auris is a music player with synced lyrics, on-device karaoke, Listen Together, Atmos-style reverb and home-screen widgets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- **The app, rebuilt on Laya and renamed.** The name, the icon, the mark and the artwork are the app's own now, on the phone, on the desktop, on Android and on TV.
- **Flow.** The endless personal mix is back: your favourites, your history and fresh finds, ordered by a tuner you steer — mood, discovery, memory and the genres to keep out.
- **YouTube can be switched off.** It is a source like any other now.
- **The app is Laya inside:** on-device karaoke, AutoMix with beat matching, synced lyrics, Listen Together, Replay, Spotify import, downloads, the equaliser and the reverb.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Auris saves your Replay and lyrics cards to your photo library when you tap Save.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Auris finds Chromecasts and Google Cast speakers on your Wi-Fi so you can play music on them.
